title: Preschool Teaching Assistant (maternity cover)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW: 

The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.

Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.

ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:

Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.

Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.

Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.

Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:

Instructional Support and Student Learning

Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.

Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.

Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.

Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.

Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.

Student Care and Learning Environment

Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.

Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).

Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.

Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.

Operational and School Support

Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.

Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.

Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.

Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.

Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.

Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.

Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed. 

Professional Conduct and Growth

Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.

Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.

Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.

Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.

Additional Responsibilities

Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.

Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school. 

Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.

Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.

Working Conditions

Walk on paths and rough terrain

Lifting backpacks and school materials

Other duties, as assigned.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Degree in Pedagogy, preferred
  • Five years experience working with children, preferred
  • PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred)
  • English level required: B2 or above
  • Portuguese level required: B2 or above

Other Skills (Desirable):

  • Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect
  • Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment
  • Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills
  • Strong professional organization skills

Child Safeguarding

Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.

EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion

EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer with strong Azure and DevOps experience to design, deploy, and support data infrastructure for our retail applications. The ideal candidate will combine data engineering skills with cloud automation and DevOps practices to ensure performance, reliability, and scalability in Azure.

This role is hybrid based in Sao Paulo on a contractual-basis, full-time hours, projected to be a year long, and for a global IT consulting firm.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain data and cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure.
  • Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines for data and application deployments.
  • Support SQL databases and BI tools (SSIS, SSRS, SSAS).
  • Automate cloud provisioning using Terraform, ARM templates, and scripting (Python, PowerShell).
  • Manage and monitor resources in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and other Azure services.
  • Implement and maintain alerting and monitoring (Azure Monitor, Grafana).
  • Ensure security, performance, and cost optimization of cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with developers and business teams to align DevOps and data practices with business needs.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 8–10+ years of IT experience with strong Azure Cloud and DevOps background.
  • Hands-on experience with AKS , VMs, networking, and Azure databases.
  • Strong SQL and data integration experience (SSIS/SSRS/SSAS) OR similar BI reporting tools .
  • Proficiency in Python and PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience with Terraform , Azure DevOps , or similar CI/CD tools.
  • Knowledge of containerization ( Docker/Kubernetes ) and infrastructure automation.
  • Familiar with cloud security and disaster recovery practices.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert or Azure Solutions Architect.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) is a plus.
  • Experience in the retail energy (power & gas) industry is an advantage.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Van Hessen is one of the leading global players in the sourcing, processing and distribution of natural casings, meat products and pharmaceuticals. We process animal by-products from slaughterhouses into high-quality food materials and raw materials for the pharmaceutical industry. Our products are 100% natural and, due to the knowledge and skills of our employees, of a very high and consistent quality. We strive to outdo ourselves every day.

About the role

Manage and coordinate the company's human resources function across subfunctions, such as recruitment, training and talent development, compensation and benefits, organization development, and employee relations, to meet company’s business requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the formation of one or more elements of functional strategy through specialist expertise and insights, to ensure that the strategy meets business needs.
  • Explore and develop a detailed understanding of external developments or emerging issues and evaluate their potential impact on, or usefulness to, the organization.
  • Deliver complex analyses of HR data; identify key trends and contribute to the creation of HR insights that enable the diagnosis of business issues, enhancement of employee engagement, and/or improvement of business performance.
  • Implement HR frameworks and tools for recruitment, performance management, development, career and succession planning, compensation and benefits, diversity, employee onboarding and offboarding, and retention of talent, within an area of expertise, to meet business or institution needs and enable the attraction, development, and retention of talent at a sustainable cost. Ensure compliance with specified design principles, internal policies, and external legal requirements.
  • Provide specialist advice on the interpretation and application of policies and procedures, resolving queries and issues and referring very complex or contentious issues to others.
  • Communicate the local action plan; explain how this relates to the function's strategy and action plan and to the broader organization's mission and vision; motivate people to achieve local business goals.
  • Help develop procedures for an area of the organization and monitor their implementation.
  • Deliver a budget for an area of the organization or conduct complex analyses on budget progress in other areas of the organization.
  • Contribute to the development and testing of HR data collection forms or questionnaires in a specific area of expertise to ensure the collection of relevant data in line with defined requirements.
  • Use the organization's formal development framework to identify the team's individual development needs. Plan and implement actions to build their capabilities. Provide training or coaching to others throughout the organization in own area of expertise to enable others to improve performance and fulfill personal potential.
  • Develop and propose own performance objectives; take appropriate actions to ensure achievement of agreed objectives, using the organization's performance management systems to improve personal performance. Or manage and report on team performance; set appropriate performance objectives for direct reports or project/account team members and hold people accountable for achieving them, taking appropriate corrective action where necessary to ensure the achievement of team/personal objectives.
  • Manage workstreams or small projects within a transformational change program, ensuring integration with related projects; use structured change management methodologies to build acceptance of change and embed desired culture and behaviours.

About you

  • Further/higher education in human resources or business discipline, with 5-8 years prior experience in HR role.
  • Experience working within a manufacturing organisation would be advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to exercise good judgement
  • A team player with a professional and flexible approach to work.
  • Innovative thinking with a passion to make a difference within the HR team and wider business.
  • Proficiency in English, Portuguese and Spanish is essential for this role.
  • A solid understanding of current employment law and HR best practice.
  • Flexible with travelling between our four sites (Paraguay, Brazil, Argentina and Chile) is required.

Location Requirement

You must live within commutable distance of our Barreiros, São José - SC, , Brazil office as weekly onsite presence is required.

If this sounds like a role that you would be interested in, then we would love to hear from you. To apply, please email a copy of your CV in English , along with a cover letter explaining the key attributes that you could bring to the role.

We value the support recruitment agencies provide, however we are unable to accept speculative CV’s from agencies we are not already engaged with.

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:

-You have experience coding at a production level in Python, Go, Scala or Java

-You’ve built and supported RBAC systems used by enterprise-wide teams

-You have experience supporting Iceberg-based data warehouses

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

title: Sr. Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Credix  

Credix is a FinTech company dedicated to growing businesses in Latin America. Building on our expertise, we now focus on providing a tailored Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solution for B2B transactions in Brazil with our platform, CrediPay. CrediPay is created to help business grow their sales and improve their cashflow efficiency through seamless and risk-free credit offering. Sellers offer their buyers flexible payment terms at an attractive price point and receive upfront payments. We manage and protect our clients from any credit & fraud risk, letting them focus only on what matters: increased sales and profitability.

Why choose Credix?

  • Become part of a forward-thinking start-up where boldness and a commitment to excellence are paramount, and your personal and professional development is at the forefront.
  • Work alongside a dedicated team of bright individuals driven by an Olympian mindset to excel in every aspect of our operations. Together, we aim to build with velocity, utilizing innovative embedded finance strategies to expand business operations in Latin America.
  • Experience a close and supportive work atmosphere where collaboration thrives, wise judgment guides our decisions, and you can learn, grow, and take on meaningful responsibilities.

About the job We are looking for someone to join Credix as a a Senior Analytics Engineer. You will take ownership of structuring our data analytics platform and analytics use-cases. You love to tackle big problems and break them down into smaller pieces. You will build an analytics platform that features reliable, timely and understandable metrics in a slice-and-dice format to empower other teams to make better decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain dbt models and reliable datasets that power analytics, experiments, and decision-making across the company.
  • Define and act upon standards for metrics, data modeling practices, and documentation.
  • Oversee the full analytics lifecycle, from transforming raw to delivering insights in BI platforms (e.g. Hex).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure analytics pipelines meet high standards of quality, observability and testing.
  • Enable self-service analytics by creating semantic layers and reusable data assets that let teams create insights independently.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a related technical data role.
  • Deep expertise with SQL and dbt, including modular modeling, documentation, and testing.
  • Proven track record of building source-of-truth data models that support product use cases.
  • Experience with cloud data warehouses (BigQuery), semantic layers (dbt), version control (Git), and visualization tools (Hex).
  • Experience in a (credit) FinTech is a must.
  • Manager of one: structuring, and executing upon the analytics roadmap.
  • Analytical and system-oriented mindset with a strong problem-solving ability to handle complex data challenges.
  • Proactive, clear and concise communication both in Portuguese and English, ensuring alignment with cross-functional teams.
  • Anticipate business metrics needs and structure the analytics layer to ensure scalability and reusability across the entire company.
  • High attention to detail and a perfectionist approach, especially in maintaining metrics quality and integrity.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment.
  • Genuine interest/passion for disrupting the B2B credit market in Brazil by using data.
  • Collaborative mindset, working effectively with diverse stakeholders.

What we offer

Collaboration and team spirit thrive best in an in-office environment. Our office provides a vibrant and engaging workspace where team members can connect, innovate, and grow. With access to our offices in Sao Paulo, you’ll immerse yourself in a culture of innovation and collaboration.

But that’s just the beginning - here’s what else we offer:

- A culture of learning and experimentation: where you are encouraged to explore new ideas and technologies

- Competitive salary package: Your hard work deserves recognition, and we ensure you’re well-rewarded for your contributions.

- Equity stock options plan: Be a part of our journey towards success and share in the rewards.

- Paid holidays: Enjoy the flexibility to recharge and rejuvenate

- Off-sites: Awesome team building, unforgettable memories, and adventures ensured during our team off-sites.

title: Gerente de Franquias
description:

· Desenvolver planogramas e padrões operacionais para potencializar o giro das principais categorias.

· Conduzir o reposicionamento comercial das lojas de conveniência, alinhado à estratégia de negócio.

· Atuar como elo estratégico entre franqueados, indústria e parceiros, fortalecendo negociações e parcerias comerciais.

· Expandir a rede de postos revendedores de lubrificantes Mobil, implementando ações de venda consultiva e aumento de volume.

· Aumentar as vendas de lubrificantes por meio de estratégias de canal, campanhas e melhoria da execução no ponto de venda.

· Liderar o processo de transformação das lojas para novos formatos, como o modelo “Esquina” .

· Coordenar e desenvolver a equipe de consultores de franquias, promovendo maturidade e alta performance.

· Garantir integração com áreas corporativas (Trade Marketing, Operações e Comercial) e alinhamento com metas de expansão.

· Monitorar indicadores de performance e resultados financeiros, atuando com visão analítica e foco em resultados.

· Promover a adesão e o engajamento dos revendedores, com abordagem consultiva, estratégica e com o foco em relacionamento.

Perfil e Requisitos

· Experiência consolidada em operações de franquias, conveniência ou varejo de energia/combustíveis.

· Atuação sólida em gestão comercial, ampliação de rede e desenvolvimento de

canais de venda.

· Forte atuação em negociação, gestão de categorias e desenvolvimento de produtos.

· Vivência em liderança de equipes comerciais consultivas, com foco em execução e resultado.

· Conhecimento em planogramas, estratégias de mix e performance por categoria.

· Perfil estratégico, com visão de negócio, capacidade analítica e foco em execução.

· Habilidade de comunicação, influência e gestão de relacionamentos com stakeholders diversos.

· Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes pelo Brasil.

Principais Desafios

· Aumentar o volume de vendas e expandir a rede de revenda de lubrificantes Mobil.

· Reestruturar e fortalecer a proposta de valor das franquias, gerando impacto direto na performance.

· Otimizar as relações comerciais com parceiros e fornecedores estratégicos.

· Aumentar a aderência e o engajamento dos revendedores ao modelo de franquia.

· Liderar a evolução da equipe, promovendo aprendizado, autonomia e resultados.

· Consolidar o modelo “Esquina” como referência no segmento de conveniência.

title: Masters / PHD In Science
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Science with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Masters / PHD In Physics
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.

About the Role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.

We are seeking a Masters / PHD In Physics with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.

Key Responsibilities:

Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing

Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:

  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills

As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Analista Gestão de Pessoas Sr.
description:
Sobre a vaga

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.

Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Atrair, identificar e selecionar os melhores talentos para atender às demandas operacionais e estratégicas da Diretoria de Logística, atuando de forma alinhada às políticas de Recursos Humanos e às diretrizes organizacionais, garantindo a eficiência dos processos seletivos e contribuindo para a formação de equipes qualificadas e alinhadas à cultura da empresa.

title: Solutions and Implementation Engineer
description:
About Us

At Qase, we’re building a better testing management platform for teams to streamline their QA processes and achieve faster releases. We’re looking for a versatile Solutions and Implementation Engineer to play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between our product, sales, and customers—driving adoption, solving problems, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.

As a fast-paced and growing startup, we move quickly and adapt often. The responsibilities outlined below reflect the current needs of the business, but may evolve over time as priorities shift and new challenges arise. Flexibility, initiative, and a willingness to adapt are key to success in this role.

We’re seeking someone who can align part of their schedule with early Eastern Standard Time (EST) working hours. 

What You'll Do Pre-Sales Responsibilities:
  • Assist Enterprise Account Executives with technical discovery calls to understand customer pain points, business outcomes, and technical requirements.
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations that align with client use cases.
  • Manage Proof-of-Concepts (POCs) to validate product fit, including test data setup, integrations, and success criteria validation.
  • Provide technical input for RFP/RFI responses and proposals, highlighting implementation feasibility and scalability.
  • Independently complete security questionnaires for customers and prospects.
Post-Sales Responsibilities:
  • Own end-to-end customer onboarding: Design, scope and execute implementation plans, including integrations and complex data migrations.
  • Lead deployment activities: environment setup, infrastructure configuration, and UAT coordination.
  • Build customer implementation playbooks , timelines, and success metrics, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
  • Serve as the technical escalation point during implementations, troubleshooting issues across APIs, authentication, and infrastructure.
  • Conduct workshops and training sessions for admins, QA engineers, and developers to ensure adoption and operational excellence.
  • Serve as the technical point of contact for escalations, offering creative solutions to complex challenges.
  • Identify upsell or cross-sell opportunities based on customer feedback and usage.
  • Create and deploy customized training sessions for new customers.
Technical Responsibilities:
  • Hands-on engineering: ability to write and iterate complex scripts, troubleshoot issues, sample code, and support integrations to accelerate adoption.
  • System design & Architecture: design and communicate solution architectures, including setting up AWS infrastructure, deploying instances, and defining infrastructure costs for customers or prospects.
  • Security & Compliance: confidently address customer and prospect security requirements by completing questionnaires, explaining our security posture, and ensuring trust in our practices.
  • Technical Documentation: create and maintain clear, reusable technical documentation such as integration guides, architecture diagrams, and solution playbooks.
Collaboration & Optimization:
  • Act as the bridge between customers and internal teams, relaying actionable feedback to improve the product.
  • Partner with Sales, Product, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth customer lifecycles.
  • Monitor customer usage trends and offer strategies to optimize value.
What You’ll Bring Core Skills: Technical Expertise:
  • Knowledge of QA processes and Test Management Systems (TMS) platforms, including APIs, CI/CD, and issue trackers.
  • Strong coding/scripting skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript).
  • Knowledge of cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) for deployments.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001).
Customer-Facing Skills:
  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and consultative skills.
  • Strong organizational skills for managing parallel implementation projects.
Problem-Solving:
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting technical issues and proposing creative, customer-focused solutions.
Experience:
  • 3+ years in implementation engineering, solutions engineering or technical account management in a SaaS environment. Preferred experience in a technical/engineering background who transitioned to customer facing responsibilities. Also considering candidates with 3+ years as an QA automation architect or engineer with strong customer facing experience. 
  • Background in Quality Assurance or certifications in cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, etc.).
  • Experience managing the customer lifecycle, from onboarding to renewal.
Tools You’ll Use:
  • CRM platforms like Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Collaboration tools like JIRA, Postman, or other API testing/reporting tools.
Soft Skills We Value:
  • Collaboration: Work seamlessly across teams and communicate with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Adaptability: Thrive in fast-paced environments with multiple ongoing engagements.
  • Empathy: A customer-first mindset with a genuine desire to help clients succeed.
Key Deliverables:
  • Deliver smooth, on-time customer implementations and migrations.
  • Drive faster time-to-value for customers through structured, seamless onboarding.
  • Shorten sales cycles with impactful technical demos.
  • Reduce churn by offering exceptional post-sales support.
  • Provide actionable feedback to the Product team to enhance the platform.

Join us at Qase and be part of a dynamic team driving the future of test management!

title: Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate - Simulation
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We combine engineering excellence with innovative digital solutions to solve real-world infrastructure challenges. From port and terminal digital twins to cloud-based inspection tools and automated 3D reconstruction, we deliver high-impact, data-driven insights to clients across the globe. We are actively looking for a Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate to join our Sao Paulo office. As part of the Flexterm Group, the Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps Associate will help build robust pipelines that power simulation workflows, Kafka-driven data ingestion, Databricks-based data transformation, and cloud-based delivery of inspection and 3D data to client platforms. This is a hybrid position and will require some in-office presence in our office in Sao Paulo, BR.

About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specializing in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbors and rivers, as well as an innovator in transportation. For the 4th year in a row, Moffatt & Nichol is Ranked #1 in Engineering News-Record for Marine & Port Facilities in the U.S. Additionally, our firm consistently ranks in the Top 100 Pure Designers in the US and the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, North America, Latin America, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customized service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in several primary practice areas – ports and harbors; coastal, environmental and water resources; urban waterfronts and marinas; transportation, bridges and rail; inspection and rehabilitation; and energy.

Duties and responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Azure Cloud Infrastructure

  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable environments using Azure (AKS, VMs, Functions, Blob Storage, App Services, etc.)
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or Bicep to deploy and maintain consistent cloud environments

CI/CD and Automation

  • Create automated CI/CD pipelines for data processing, simulation, and 3D asset workflows
  • Enable cross-team automation for simulation engineers, inspection groups, and digital twin platform developers

Kafka & Databricks Pipelines

  • Set up and manage Kafka-based data ingestion from external platforms.
  • Integrate with Databricks for real-time and batch processing of simulation data, crack detection outputs, and inspection datasets

Simulation & Twin Integration

  • Deploy and orchestrate compute-heavy simulation jobs in the cloud
  • Integrate simulation results into real-time digital twin systems, enabling actionable insights on equipment performance and operational planning

3D Reconstruction & Inspection Workflows

  • Automate cloud-based 3D model reconstruction from inspection datasets (e.g., point clouds, drone imagery, crack detection outputs)
  • Package and deliver reconstructed 3D models and annotated inspection results via secure client portals or custom viewers

Client-Facing Delivery & Collaboration

  • Build secure sharing mechanisms for inspection reports, simulation results, and 3D models
  • Ensure reliable, auditable delivery pipelines that meet client compliance and usability needs

Security, Monitoring, and Resilience

  • Implement best practices in cloud security, encryption, and access control
  • Monitor systems using Azure Monitor, ELK, or Prometheus/Grafana to ensure availability, scalability, and performance

Other duties:

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Required qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering degree (Software or Computer Engineering)
  • 4-8 years of experience
  • Strong experience with Azure services: AKS, Blob, Functions, App Gateway, and Networking
  • Proficient with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration at scale
  • Proficient with CI/CD tools: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins
  • Hands-on with Kafka, including configuration, message flows, and monitoring
  • Experienced in Databricks: notebooks, pipelines, Delta Lake, and cluster management
  • Proficient in Python, Bash, or other scripting languages for automation
  • Skilled in infrastructure-as-code using Terraform or Bicep

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related engineering degree
  • Familiarity with computer vision pipelines, crack detection, or point cloud processing
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Installers (MSI)
  • Experience creating digitally signed application installers and collaborating with QA for deployment testing
  • Understanding REST APIs, event-driven architecture, and real-time data delivery
  • Prior experience supporting engineering or infrastructure-focused teams
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171
  • Moffatt & Nichol uses E-Verify and employment is contingent upon the legal ability to obtain employment in the U.S. and to present the required documentation at hire

title: Testing & commissioning Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Testing and commissioning Engineer to join our dynamic team for Data Center projects in Brazil. This position demands a solid foundation in electrical engineering, particularly in testing and Commissioning power generation equipment. The ideal candidate will ensure that all equipment and systems adhere to Industry standards and regulatory requirements through thorough and safe testing processes. Responsibilities will encompass managing all aspects of testing, including Factory acceptance Tests (FAT), Site acceptance Tests (Sat), and Integrated Systems Tests (IST). The engineer should be proficient in developing and executing test plans That align with customer needs while maintaining clear communication with the factory.

Key responsibilities:

  • Actual participation in testing and commissioning activities including FAT, SAT, and IST;
  • Ensure adherence to industry regulations and safety standards during testing and commissioning processes;
  • Develop and implement testing protocols to validate system functionality and performance according to customer specificity;
  • Diagnose and resolve technical issues related to testing and commissioning;
  • Collaborate with project teams to incorporate testing and commissioning activities into overall project plans;
  • Preparing project documentation, including test reports, commissioning plans, and equipment manuals;
  • Participate in project meetings and effectively communicate with stakeholders to achieve project goals.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field is preferred;
  • Proven experience in testing and commissioning power generator preferred;
  • Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to electrical testing and commissioning (E.g., IEEE, IEC, NEC);
  • Strong troubleshooting abilities and capacity to analyze complex electrical systems;
  • Experience in project management or coordination is a plus;
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills;
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team;
  • Strong commitment to safety and quality;
  • This position may require travel to project sites or customer locations, both locally and internationally as needed.

*Please note that this is a 1 year renewable contract position*

title: Especialista de Customer Success (Inteligência de Dados e IA)
description:
Atuar como elo estratégico entre clientes na área de Inteligência de Dados, garantindo a adoção, retenção e expansão do valor entregue pelas soluções de dados e inteligência artificial. Conduzir iniciativas de engajamento e suporte consultivo, promovendo uma experiência positiva ao cliente, assegurando conformidade com práticas de governança e privacidade, e gerando insights que potencializem o uso responsável e eficiente dos dados.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como ponto focal de clientes estratégicos da área de Inteligência de Dados, garantindo engajamento, adoção e satisfação contínua.
  • Mapear jornadas de clientes, entendendo necessidades, desafios e oportunidades de expansão de valor.
  • Monitorar métricas de sucesso do cliente (NPS, churn, adoção de funcionalidades, ROI) e propor planos de ação para melhoria contínua.

  • Traduzir necessidades dos clientes em requisitos claros para as equipes de Inteligência de Dados, Governança de Dados e Inteligência Artificial.
  • Garantir que as práticas de governança, compliance (LGPD, GDPR) e ética em IA estejam refletidas na experiência do cliente.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em Customer Success, BizDev ou áreas de tecnologias.
  • Experiência em métricas de sucesso do cliente (NPS, churn, adoção, engajamento).
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita, com habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos em linguagem de negócios.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) e familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM (Salesforce, Hubspot, Gainsight ou similares).

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Certificações em Customer Success (SuccessHacker, Gainsight, etc.).
  • Experiência em apresentações executivas e relatórios para clientes corporativos.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para interação com stakeholders globais.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Buscamos pessoas que sejam movidas por paixões como a que inspirou o nascimento do Grupo, e que juntamente conosco, estejam dispostas a assumirem os desafios e continuarem escrevendo nossa história!

Uma maneira de cultivar a mudança é criando um ambiente de trabalho mais diverso e inclusivo, como cultura organizacional. Para isso, estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente que seja livre de discriminação e assédio onde todas as pessoas se sintam respeitadas e valorizadas.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Garantir que 100% da equipe realize os treinamentos online. Ser o multiplicador das estratégias da companhia, liderando pelo exemplo, sendo porta voz de todas as comunicações, garantindo a alta qualidade nos atendimentos

title: Key Account Manager
description:
ompany Overview:

Anker Innovations is a global leader in charging technology and a developer of consumer electronics and smart devices. We are committed to bringing innovative products to our customers and ensuring the highest standards of quality and service. As we expand our presence in Latam, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced Channel Specialist to join our team

Key Responsibilities:

As a Channel Specialist, you will be the cornerstone of our channel expansion and management efforts in Brazil. Your core duties will include:

  • Project Coordination & Lead Management: Take ownership of the regional distributor recruitment project by collecting, organizing, and managing all distributor leads generated by our sales advisors.
  • Distributor Screening & Onboarding: Conduct preliminary screenings of potential distributors based on established criteria, proactively contact and qualify candidates in target regions, and build a structured pipeline. You will collaborate with our headquarters team to finalize the selection of new distributors.
  • Account Management & Growth: Manage and support the ongoing relationship with appointed regional distributors. This includes facilitating orders, managing procurement processes, monitoring sales targets, and ultimately being accountable for the sales performance and revenue growth within your channel.

Qualifications:

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven professional with:

  • Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in both Portuguese and English is mandatory.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of relevant experience in sales, channel management, or key account management.
  • Industry Knowledge: Prior experience in the consumer electronics industry is highly preferred.
  • Cultural Affinity: Experience working with or for a Chinese company is a significant advantage.
  • Personal Attributes: A self-starter with a strong sense of initiative, excellent resilience under pressure, and a genuine enthusiasm for embracing change and challenges. You must be a quick learner who can rapidly apply new knowledge to your work.

We Offer:

  • A pivotal role in the expansion of a globally recognized and beloved brand.
  • A dynamic, fast-paced, and supportive international work environment.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

title: Analista de Processos - Jr
description:
Description

Você terá a oportunidade de evoluir sua carreira na maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo atuando como Analista de Processos Júnior.

Na sua rotina, você irá:

  • Entender o processo
  • Desenhar todo processo com o passo a passo em como será os detalhes

Os líderes da Deloitte vivem o nosso propósito: gerar impactos positivos. Energizam, empoderam, conectam, interagem, reagem e pensam de formas diferentes. Por isso, buscamos pessoas que são inspiradoras, criam ambientes diversos, influenciam uma cultura colaborativa e, com isso, entregam valor. Nossa liderança é peça-chave para o nosso crescimento.

Acreditamos na força dos talentos que preparamos. Eles transformam de fato, impactam organizações, impulsionam mais talentos e criam oportunidades. Que tal fazer parte da maior organização de serviços profissionais do mundo? Escolha seu impacto.

Requirements

O que precisa para você se candidatar à vaga?

  • Formação de nível superior
  • Curso de gestão de processo com carga horário mínima de 40 horas
  • Possuir no mínimo 2 anos de experiência em projetos de consultoria em gestão
  • por processos (modelagem de processos; técnicas de melhoria de processos; e modelos e ferramentas de gestão).

Benefits

Desenvolvimento profissional

É claro que cuidaríamos do seu desenvolvimento aqui na Deloitte! Queremos que você alcance seus objetivos profissionais e pessoais e, por isso, contamos com acesso a plataformas online de aprendizado, plataforma de idiomas com mais de 7.500 conteúdos e cerca de 60 cursos divididos por nível, área de atuação, habilidades profissionais e interesses, Universidade Corporativa e até uma plataforma que reúne diversas instituições de ensino, fornecendo descontos exclusivos para profissionais Deloitte e seus dependentes.

Além disso, oferecemos um plano mentorias com profissionais da Deloitte para que você possa ter uma visão complementar e direcionamentos sobre o seu crescimento. É ótimo ter uma pessoa mentora, não é mesmo?

Cuidados com o seu bem-estar

Aqui na Deloitte, acreditamos que saúde e bem-estar não são apenas projetos, e sim uma mudança de cultura. Queremos que você coloque em prática todo o seu talento e desenvolva uma carreira de sucesso com a gente, com equilíbrio entre Mente, Corpo e Propósito. Para isso, contamos com mais de 30 benefícios, como:

  • Serviço de telemedicina para que você consiga fazer uma pré-avaliação sem precisar sair de casa!
  • Family Strategy: programa destinados à profissionais gestantes e futuros papais que terão todo apoio possível neste momento tão especial
  • Wellhub (Gympass) para colocar os exercícios físicos em dia
  • Dia de folga no mês do seu aniversário, para celebrar uma das pessoas mais importantes de sua vida
  • Canal de apoio psicológico e Serviço Social

(Mais) Benefícios

  • Assistência médica e odontológica! Para que você faça check-ups e cuide de você, em primeiro lugar*
  • Participação nos lucros. Afinal, sem os nossos talentos, não poderíamos crescer exponencialmente
  • Auxílio-internet, para apoiar no trabalho em modelo híbrido
  • Seguro de vida*
  • Vale refeição / alimentação*
  • Pacote de benefícios flexíveis: você receberá pontos e poderá distribui-los entre as opções que melhor se adequam às suas necessidades de acordo com as regras do programa.

Oportunidade de fazer parte de uma cultura inclusiva

Você pode ser quem realmente é com oportunidade igual de crescimento. Para reforçar esse compromisso, desenvolvemos a estratégia global de D&I com os 5 pilares – Origens, Delas, LGBT+, Inclui e Gerações. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas estão abertas ao público PcD.

Esperamos você neste time!

title: CRA II or Senior CRA
description:
We are currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in designing and analyzing clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes. Activities include qualifying potential investigative sites, initiating clinical trials, maintaining study files, providing instructions to site personnel and study close out.
  • Verifies the protection of study participants by confirming informed consent procedures and protocol have been performed in accordance to applicable regulations.
  • Ensures the integrity of clinical data and that the study is conducted in compliance with approved protocol, GCP, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Manages the investigative site staff to facilitate trial deliverables, e.g., subject enrollment, data deliverables.
  • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).
  • Writes and submits reports of investigational site findings and updates applicable tracking systems. Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.
  • Manages essential documents as required by local regulations and ICH-GCP guidelines before, during and after a clinical study; assists with resolution of investigational site/data queries.
  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.
  • Independently performs a variety of onsite and offsite monitoring visit types.
  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.
  • May serve as preceptor, providing training to less experienced clinical team members.
  • Undergraduate degree or international equivalent in clinical, science, or healthrelated field from an accredited institution; health care professional licensure, i.e., registered nurse
  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.
  • Travel is required 50-80%.
  • All employees must read, write and speak fluent English and host country language
What ICON Can Offer You
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
Visit our careers website to read more about the benefits of working at ICON:

ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below. Interested in the role, but unsure if you meet all of the requirements? We would encourage you to apply regardless – there’s every chance you’re exactly what we’re looking for here at ICON whether it is for this or other roles.

title: Coordenador de dados (Exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência)
description:
Conheça melhor a unidade de negócio que essa vaga pertence:

Nosso time de Dados é estratégico para transformar informações em decisões inteligentes e impactantes em todas as frentes de negócio.

Buscamos um(a) Coordenador(a) de Dados para liderar iniciativas analíticas e de engenharia de dados, garantindo que a infraestrutura, os pipelines e a qualidade da informação suportem as necessidades das áreas corporativas e de produto.

A pessoa selecionada atuará tanto na frente técnica — entregando projetos robustos de Data Analytics e Data Engineering — quanto na frente de gestão, liderando e desenvolvendo um time multidisciplinar. Será responsável por promover a cultura orientada a dados, facilitar a tomada de decisão estratégica e garantir que as entregas estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas e necessidades da empresa.

Se você possui sólida experiência técnica, soma habilidades de liderança e quer elevar a maturidade analítica do negócio, essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Coordenar iniciativas de Data Analytics e Data Engineering, garantindo disponibilidade, qualidade e performance dos dados.
  • Gerenciar projetos de construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados, integrações e modelagens analíticas.
  • Atuar como facilitador(a) entre áreas de negócio, produto e tecnologia para traduzir necessidades estratégicas em soluções de dados.
  • Desenvolver e implementar métricas, dashboards e relatórios que tragam inteligência para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Liderar, motivar e desenvolver o time de dados, impulsionando entregas de alta qualidade e crescimento profissional.
  • Garantir governança e segurança dos dados de acordo com políticas internas e regulamentações (LGPD, compliance).
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados, promovendo automações e inovações.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida com linguagens de consulta e programação: SQL, Python, Pandas, PySpark.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL/ELT, orquestração e integração de dados (Airflow)..
  • Vivência em arquitetura de dados, modelagem dimensional e relacional.
  • Experiência com ambientes de Big Data e cloud computing (AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experiência em GitHub para versionamento de códigos.
  • Domínio de ferramentas de visualização e BI (Power BI, Tableau, Databricks, Looker).
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de engenharia de dados e governança.
  • Entendimento de métricas de negócio e indicadores de performance.

(Habilidades Comportamentais):

  • Liderança: Capacidade de inspirar, orientar e desenvolver equipes, promovendo colaboração e engajamento.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva: Consegue traduzir temas técnicos para públicos não técnicos e vice-versa.
  • Visão estratégica: Saber priorizar iniciativas que tragam maior impacto para o negócio.
  • Resolução de problemas: Raciocínio lógico aliado à criatividade para propor soluções inovadoras.
  • Adaptabilidade: Flexível diante de mudanças rápidas e novos desafios.
  • Gestão de conflitos: Habilidade de mediar e resolver divergências de forma construtiva.
  • Orientação a resultados: Foco na entrega de valor com qualidade e dentro dos prazos.

O que oferecemos:

Vale-refeição: R$ 880,00 mensais.

Auxílio home office ou mobilidade: R$ 403,00 mensais (de acordo com o modelo de trabalho).

Plano de saúde: Bradesco Saúde (para colaboradores de SP) ou Unimed Nacional (para os demais estados), com cobertura para titular + 1 dependente pagos integralmente pela empresa. Demais dependentes podem ser incluídos com custo adicional.

Gympass: acesso a academias e programas de bem-estar em todo o Brasil.

Plano de carreira estruturado, com trilhas de desenvolvimento e oportunidades internas.

Programa de vantagens, com benefícios e descontos exclusivos em parceiros.

title: ANALISTA PROJETOS MECÂNICOS
description:
Somos uma indústria brasileira movida por propósito: transformar a cana-de-açúcar em soluções que geram energia, açúcar, combustível limpo e bem-estar para o mundo.

Fundada no interior paulista, o orgulho de nossa história de mais de 75 anos é reflexo do empenho de nossas pessoas, que imaginaram, inovaram e cresceram conosco. Hoje, nossas quatro unidades agroindustriais, localizadas em Lençóis Paulista, Macatuba, Quatá e Lucélia, junto aos nossos escritórios administrativos em Lençóis Paulista e em São Paulo, nos posicionam como uma das maiores empresas do país no setor sucroenergético.

Se você é movido(a) por desafios e quer fazer parte de um time que constrói o futuro com eficiência, impacto e responsabilidade, a Zilor é o seu lugar.

#VempraZilor

Responsabilidade:

Apoiar no desenvolvimento e acompanhamento de projetos mecânicos em indústria, atuando desde a concepção até a implementação, garantindo o atendimento das normas de qualidade e segurança industrial em busca de soluções técnicas eficazes, economicamente viáveis e sustentáveis.

  • Conhecimento avançado em dimensionamento mecânico, cálculos e checagem de tubulações industriais e especificação de materiais.

Responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar previsões de vendas e relatórios gerenciais para a diretoria.
  • Gerenciar pedidos e controlar prazos de entregas.

Requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Marketing, Gestão Comercial, Moda ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência comprovada de no mínimo 4 anos como Key Account Manager ou função similar.
  • Forte habilidade de negociação, gestão de equipes e planejamento estratégico.
  • Experiência em trabalhar com metas e entrega de resultados.
  • Conhecimento dos canais de vendas (varejo, atacado e e-commerce) e comportamento do consumidor de moda.

  • Habilidade em relacionamento interpessoal e engajamento de pares e colaboradores.
  • Alta capacidade de gestão de conflitos e negociações complexas.

title: Programador web
description:
Estamos à procura de uma Pessoa Programadora Web!

Junte-se ao nosso time e seja a peça-chave para dar vida a experiências digitais incríveis, impulsionando a presença online da nossa empresa e criando um impacto real para nossos usuários.

Resumo do Cargo

Como Pessoa Programadora Web em nossa empresa, você será responsável por desenvolver, implementar e manter soluções web de alta qualidade e performance, com foco especial na plataforma WordPress. Você atuará na linha de frente da criação e manutenção do nosso site institucional e portal de notícias, transformando necessidades de negócio em funcionalidades robustas. Sua expertise será crucial para gerenciar nosso fluxo de conteúdo digital e implementar soluções de publicidade, garantindo uma plataforma escalável, atualizada e eficiente.

Como Você Terá Sucesso Neste Cargo

Você terá sucesso ao:

  • Dominar o WordPress: Customizar temas, desenvolver plugins personalizados e gerenciar a arquitetura completa do WordPress para atender às necessidades específicas do negócio.
  • Otimizar a Gestão de Conteúdo: Implementar e manter um fluxo eficiente de publicação de notícias e materiais editoriais, garantindo interface intuitiva para a equipe de conteúdo.
  • Implementar Soluções de Publicidade: Integrar e gerenciar sistemas de anúncios e monetização, assegurando a correta veiculação e acompanhamento de campanhas publicitárias.
  • Ser Colaborativa e Comunicativa: Trabalhar de forma integrada com outras pessoas desenvolvedoras, designers, equipe de conteúdo e marketing, comunicando-se com clareza sobre prazos e requisitos técnicos.
  • Manter-se Constantemente Atualizada: Mostrar curiosidade e proatividade para aprender novas tecnologias e melhores práticas, trazendo inovação contínua para nossos projetos.

Como Este Cargo se Encaixa na Organização

Nossa equipe de tecnologia é o coração que impulsiona a inovação na empresa. Como Pessoa Programadora Web especializada em WordPress, você será fundamental para nossa estratégia de comunicação digital e presença online. Seu trabalho irá sustentar diretamente nossos canais de notícias e iniciativas de marketing, impactando milhares de usuários diariamente e contribuindo para os objetivos de negócio através da publicidade digital. Valorizamos um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo onde cada contribuição é valorizada e onde você terá a oportunidade de crescer profissionalmente junto conosco.

Responsabilidades
  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter sites em WordPress, incluindo customização de temas e desenvolvimento de plugins personalizados.
  • Gerenciar a estrutura e o fluxo de publicação de notícias, criando e otimizando taxonomias, campos personalizados e tipos de conteúdo.
  • Implementar e integrar soluções de publicidade no site, incluindo gestão de espaços publicitários, inserção de códigos de terceiros e configuração de ads.txt.
  • Garantir a performance, segurança e SEO dos sites em WordPress, realizando otimizações técnicas regulares.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de marketing e conteúdo para implementar novas funcionalidades e layouts para notícias e seções especiais.
  • Realizar a manutenção e atualização de plugins e do core do WordPress, garantindo a estabilidade do ambiente.
  • Desenvolver e manter a integração do WordPress com outros sistemas da empresa através de APIs REST.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica sobre a estrutura e funcionamento do site.
Qualificações

Competências e Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento WordPress, incluindo criação de temas e plugins personalizados.
  • Domínio de HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript e PHP.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are. Who We Are We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included. As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few! Job Description Your Career The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies. Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio. Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager, you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information The Team Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients. As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step. Our Commitment We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Seu trabalho impactará diretamente a experiência dos nossos usuários e o sucesso das nossas entregas estratégicas.

  • Desenvolver e manter APIs RESTful robustas, seguras e de alta performance utilizando Python, com foco nos frameworks Django e/ou FastAPI.
  • Implementar interfaces de usuário (UI) modernas, responsivas e acessíveis utilizando React.js, consumindo os serviços de back-end de forma eficiente.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (Produto, Design/UX e outros desenvolvedores) para analisar, definir e traduzir requisitos de negócio em especificações técnicas funcionais.

  • Estruturar, implementar e otimizar esquemas de bancos de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL) para suportar as necessidades das aplicações.
  • Identificar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance e bugs (debugging) em todo o stack (front-end e back-end).

Requisitos Essenciais:

  • Experiência: Experiência profissional sólida e comprovada em desenvolvimento web Full Stack.
  • Competências (Back-end): Proficiência em Python e experiência prática demonstrável com Django ou FastAPI.
  • Competências (Front-end): Proficiência em React.js e seu ecossistema.
  • Fundamentos Web: Sólidos conhecimentos em HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript.
  • Banco de Dados: Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL) e modelagem de dados.
